title: Overworld 2 (old crystal sword)
body:
Welcome to Overworld 2, also known as Old Crystal Sword
This is my first mod and that is why it can look bad. It adds a second overworld. If you are interested into he lore, check my journals.
The mods adds:
- Overworld 2 dimension - created with the portal frame block:
  - Portal Frame Block - craft it with blocks of iron, redstone, copper, gold, netherite, diamonds and emeralds - short: all the mineral ones except for lapis block. Lapis lazuli in item form is needed and a banner.
  - To ignite the portal, you need to throw flint in place of the bottles in brewing stand. Blaze powder is needed like by usual brewing(the preview images show it) - tutaj musisz coś popoprawiać, bo trudno mi jest ogarnąć
  - When you enter the dimnension, you get regeneration effect
- Warning block - a WIP, decorative block
  
 
Can be use in modpack
THANK FOR EnnyTheDonkey
If you want to make movie, addon for this mod or other thinghs, say in comment on PMC!
